problem:
Problem description
- There is a finite planning horizon of $$T$$ periods indexed by $$t \in \mathcal{T}=\{1,2,\ldots,T\}$$.
- The firm trades one or more grain categories indexed by $$g \in \mathcal{G}=\{1,2,\ldots,G\}$$.
- The planning input includes initial inventory $$I_{g,0}$$ for each grain category and initial cash balance $$B_0$$.
- Each period has an exogenous purchase price $$c_{g,t}$$ and selling price $$s_{g,t}$$ for each grain category.
- The warehouse has a finite storage capacity $$K$$ for total on-hand inventory across all grain categories.
- Purchases made in period $$t$$ are delivered in period $$t$$ and are paid for immediately upon delivery.
- Goods purchased in period $$t$$ cannot be sold until period $$t+1$$ or later.
- Sales in any period may only use inventory that is already eligible for sale at the start of that period.
- The cash balance must remain feasible throughout the horizon, with no negative cash unless an explicit financing source is provided.
- The inventory held in the warehouse at any time must never exceed the storage capacity $$K$$.
- The ending inventory at the end of period $$T$$ must satisfy the required terminal inventory level $$I^{\mathrm{req}}_g$$ for each grain category.
- The optimization goal is to maximize total trading profit over the horizon, using the period-by-period purchase and sales decisions.

- A solution is represented by:
  - $$x_{g,t}$$, the quantity of grain category $$g$$ purchased in period $$t$$.
  - $$y_{g,t}$$, the quantity of grain category $$g$$ sold in period $$t$$.
  - $$I_{g,t}$$, the ending inventory of grain category $$g$$ after period $$t$$.
  - $$B_t$$, the cash balance after period $$t$$.
  - $$\Pi$$, the total profit over the full planning horizon.

Input Format
{
  "T": "number of planning periods, indexed by $$t \\in \\mathcal{T}=\\{1,2,\\ldots,T\\}$$",
  "G": "number of grain categories, indexed by $$g \\in \\mathcal{G}=\\{1,2,\\ldots,G\\}$$",
  "K": "warehouse capacity for total inventory",
  "B_0": "initial cash balance",
  "I_0": "initial inventory vector with shape $$G$$, where $$I_{g,0}$$ is the initial stock of grain category $$g$$",
  "I^{\\mathrm{req}}": "required ending inventory vector with shape $$G$$, where $$I^{\\mathrm{req}}_g$$ is the terminal stock requirement for grain category $$g$$",
  "c": "purchase price matrix with shape $$G \\times T$$, where $$c_{g,t}$$ is the unit purchase cost of grain category $$g$$ in period $$t$$",
  "s": "selling price matrix with shape $$G \\times T$$, where $$s_{g,t}$$ is the unit selling price of grain category $$g$$ in period $$t$$",
  "receipt_lag": "sellability delay in periods; here the rule is that purchased goods become sellable only after one period",
  "payment_rule": "purchase payment is due upon delivery in the purchase period",
  "demand": "not exogenous in this problem; sales are decision variables limited by sellable inventory and timing rules"
}

Output Format
{
  "purchase_plan": {
    "shape": "$$G \\times T$$",
    "meaning": "$$x_{g,t}$$, purchased quantity of grain category $$g$$ in period $$t$$"
  },
  "sales_plan": {
    "shape": "$$G \\times T$$",
    "meaning": "$$y_{g,t}$$, sold quantity of grain category $$g$$ in period $$t$$"
  },
  "ending_inventory": {
    "shape": "$$G$$",
    "meaning": "$$I_{g,T}$$, ending inventory of each grain category after period $$T$$"
  },
  "ending_cash": {
    "shape": "scalar",
    "meaning": "$$B_T$$, cash balance at the end of period $$T$$"
  },
  "total_profit": {
    "shape": "scalar",
    "meaning": "$$\\Pi$$, total profit over the planning horizon"
  }
}

Example(s)

Input 1
{
  "T": 3,
  "G": 1,
  "K": 5000,
  "B_0": 20000,
  "I_0": [1000],
  "I^{\\mathrm{req}}": [2000],
  "c": [[2.85, 3.05, 2.90]],
  "s": [[3.10, 3.25, 2.95]],
  "receipt_lag": 1,
  "payment_rule": "purchase payment is due upon delivery in the same month"
}

parameters.name: num_periods
parameters.description: Number of trading periods in the planning horizon

parameters.name: warehouse_capacity
parameters.description: Maximum total on-hand inventory that can be stored in the warehouse

parameters.name: initial_inventory
parameters.description: Initial inventory vector by grain category

parameters.name: required_terminal_inventory
parameters.description: Required ending inventory vector by grain category

parameters.name: purchase_price
parameters.description: Purchase price matrix by grain category and period

parameters.name: selling_price
parameters.description: Selling price matrix by grain category and period

parameters.name: receipt_lag
parameters.description: Number of periods before purchased inventory becomes eligible for sale

parameters.name: payment_rule
parameters.description: Timing rule indicating that purchases are paid upon delivery in the purchase period

variables.name: purchase_quantity
variables.description: Quantity of grain category purchased in each period

variables.name: sales_quantity
variables.description: Quantity of grain category sold in each period

variables.name: ending_inventory
variables.description: Ending inventory of each grain category after each period

variables.name: total_profit
variables.description: Total profit over the full planning horizon

constraints.name: ending_inventory_nonnegative
constraints.description: Ending inventory must be nonnegative for each grain category and period

constraints.name: cash_balance_nonnegative
constraints.description: Cash balance must remain nonnegative throughout the horizon

constraints.name: warehouse_capacity_limit
constraints.description: Total on-hand inventory across all grain categories cannot exceed warehouse capacity

constraints.name: sale_eligibility_lag
constraints.description: Inventory purchased in a period cannot be sold until the following period or later
constraints.formula: x[g][t] and y[g][t] with receipt lag

constraints.name: terminal_inventory_requirement
constraints.description: Ending inventory at the end of the horizon must meet the required terminal inventory for each grain category

constraints.name: inventory_balance
constraints.description: Inventory balance for each grain category and period, with purchases added and sales removed; for the first period, initial inventory is used as the starting level, and for later periods previous ending inventory is carried forward.

constraints.name: cash_balance_update
constraints.description: Cash balance evolution by period, assuming purchases are paid upon delivery in the same period and sales revenue is received in the same period.

constraints.name: warehouse_capacity_total
constraints.description: Total inventory across all grain categories at the end of each period cannot exceed warehouse capacity.

constraints.name: terminal_inventory_satisfaction
constraints.description: Ending inventory at the end of the horizon must meet the required terminal inventory for each grain category.

constraints.name: purchase_sales_nonnegativity
constraints.description: Decision variables for purchases and sales are nonnegative, and inventory and cash remain nonnegative over the horizon.
constraints.formula: x_{g,t}\ge 0,\ y_{g,t}\ge 0,\ I_{g,t}\ge 0,\ B_t\ge 0\quad \forall g\in\mathcal{G},\ t\in\mathcal{T}

objectives.name: total_trading_profit
objectives.description: Maximize total trading profit over the planning horizon

final_objective.description: Maximize total trading profit over the planning horizon as final cash minus initial cash, equivalently cumulative sales revenue minus cumulative purchase cost.
